title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1977-04-27
lineage: 1st Generation Reel (Technics RS-1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2024 > TLH flac2496
source: Barry Glassberg's Master FM Reel (Pioneer TX9500 tuner > TEAC A3300S Reel @ 7 1/2 ips, Maxell UD180B) > 1st Generation Reel  @ 3 3/4 ips

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding soundboard marred by amplified crowd noise and long tuning breaks; Morning Dew shines.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that suffers from jarring, over‑amplified audience sections between tracks and excessive on‑stage tuning (15–20 minutes in set 1). Musically the show has moments – notably a stellar “Morning Dew” – but the constant retuning interrupts the flow. Overall the technical flaws outweigh the performance strengths for most listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, rating 2 stars; shows a decent performance but recording issues dominate, leading to an overall low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Amplified crowd noise inserted between songs with fade‑ins/outs, causing jarring transitions; long tuning periods (15–20 min) interrupt the music.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Interrupted by frequent and lengthy on‑stage tunings; crowd noise edits break continuity, making the set feel disjointed.
